description: Inside a busy restaurant a waitress takes plates of food from the kitchen pass while a chef in whites hands them over. Waiters in white shirts and dark aprons carry stacked plates through the dining room between white-clothed tables, and a waitress sets a cappuccino down on the bar counter in front of a guest. At the end the whole team - waiters, waitresses, the chef and the manager - crowd together in front of the open kitchen with their arms round each other, shouting and laughing into the camera as one group.
